title: How to get there — La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
publisher: La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
claims: Cortina d'Ampezzo is in the north-east of the Veneto region, province of Belluno, about 72 km from the city of Belluno and only 44 km from the Austrian border; the page calls it one of the most famous mountain tourist destinations in Italy.
A daily bus service and private shuttle buses travel from Venice airport to Cortina in a little less than two hours; Venice is the closest airport.
From Venice airport the operators named by the event are Flixbus, Cortina Express and ATVO; summer bus schedules connecting Venice Airport to Cortina are published at the end of April.

By car from the south: A13 Bologna-Padova, A4 Milano-Venezia, A27 to Belluno, exit Pian di Vedoia, then SS 51 Alemagna towards Dobbiaco and Cortina; from the north: A22 Brennero south, exit Bressanone, then towards Dobbiaco and Cortina.
The page says it covers car, train and plane, but it contains no train section, station name, timetable or journey time.
